description: This file provides utility functions for extracting text content from various file formats (.txt, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx). It supports reading raw bytes from files and returning the extracted text along with potential errors. It also includes a function for summarizing text previews. The code leverages external libraries: pdfminer.six for PDF extraction and python-docx for DOCX files.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Main interface that detects file type by extension and extracts text accordingly, supporting .txt, .pdf, .docx, and .xlsx files.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Decodes byte content as UTF-8 text, ignoring errors.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Uses pdfminer.six to extract text from PDF byte content.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Uses python-docx to extract text from DOCX files, including paragraphs and table cells.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Creates a short preview string from a larger text, collapsing whitespace and limiting length.

ctags.pattern: /^def extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes) -> Tuple[str, Optional[str]]:$/
